posts.author: gaydarade
posts.body:
@TheRamenGirl
2 possible solutions for you.
1. With Shaz's script, I can't get the z-index argument to update after it has been assigned, and some of the other attributes too, like zoom and hue. Even erasing and rebuilding fogs did not work for me. It's much easier to control the layering by changing which image is assigned to which fog id.
For a simple example, the following will flip-flop which image is shown on top.
Code:
if whatever
    show_fog(1, "image1")
    show_fog(2, "image2")
else
    show_fog(1, "image2")
    show_fog(2, "image1")
end
Here's a screenshot of the example I made in a test project to confirm this.
2. You can try to use Victor's Fog & Overlay instead. I've had a lot more luck with it in all of my overlay mapping.
